args.prompt: The creature is cute, silly and friendly, never scary, in the same chunky pixel style and outline as the cat-unicorn reference sheet. A cute MARSHMALLOW GHOST: a plump white fluffy marshmallow ghost with a wavy tail, pink cheeks, big round eyes and a small round open mouth. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, every frame the same size and all on the same invisible ground line, plenty of empty space between frames so no frame touches another. Side view facing left. Frames: (1)-(4) floating bob cycle with the tiny arms up, mid, down, mid; (5)-(6) puffed up 'boo' pose with wide eyes; (7)-(8) squashed and dizzy with spiral eyes and tiny stars. Each creature is about 16 percent of the image height. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text, no labels, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
